stories.title: Warcraft 3 Reforged: Forsaken Kingdom Video Review - IGN
stories.summary: Warcraft 3 Reforged: Forsaken Kingdom reviewed by Len Hafer on PC."It's been a long wait for any new single-player RTS stories in the Warcraft universe. And while it's hard to say a drought that long was worth it, I'm not at all displeased with what we got in the end. I would have loved more RTS-style missions in Forsaken Kingdom, but the deeper RPG mechanics and a story that fits right into the Warcraft 3 era seamlessly kept me hooked to the end. Definitive Edition is now for sure my favorite graphical style of the ones available – if only it were available for the old campaigns, which I still love to replay every few years. And a new multiplayer hero has made the ladder feel dynamic and interesting again in a big, visible way."

stories.title: Deck of Haunts - Official Console Release Date Trailer - IGN
stories.summary: Deck of Haunts gets a new trailer and a console release date. Check out the latest Deck of Haunts trailer to see gameplay and more from this sinister deckbuilding roguelike game, where players become a malevolent haunted house. New additions to the console release include new cards and rooms, new starter decks and creative deck building, missions, story, and meta-progression, expanded room-building and human navigation, nightmare mode and the Grim Reaper, new creatures, curated scenarios, and more quality-of-life features and controller improvements.Deck of Haunts will be available on Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox One, and Xbox Series X|S on October 8, 2026. It is already available on PC.
